scripts.migrate:clickhouse: CLICKHOUSE_DB=${CLICKHOUSE_DB:-lumen} bash -c 'db="$CLICKHOUSE_DB"; envsubst < clickhouse/migrations/001_events.sql | tr "\n" " " | sed "s/; */;\n/g" | while read -r stmt; do [ -n "$stmt" ] && echo "$stmt" | curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8123/ --data-binary @- > /dev/null; done; echo "ClickHouse migration complete (db=$db)"'
scripts.ci: pnpm install && pnpm turbo lint && pnpm turbo check-types && pnpm knip && pnpm turbo test
